item.title: CNIPA Releases 2025 Statistics – Total Patent Grants Down 16% YoY
item.description: China’s National Intellectual Property Administration (CNIPA) has recently released full year statistics for 2025. Overall grants (including invention, utility model and design patents) were down 16.18% compared to 2024. Invention patent grants were down 7%, utility model patent grants were down 27.28% and design patent grants were up 3.56%. item.description: In light of recent severe weather events, employers with round-the-clock operations—such as those in healthcare and other essential services—are likely facing workforce coverage concerns.
